account.title: Account
account.notePlaceholder: Optional — e.g. carried over from previous system

balance.title: Balance
balance.nothingBilled: Nothing billed yet — a balance appears once the first visit is completed.
balance.settled: Nothing outstanding. This patient’s account is fully settled.
balance.credit: Credit {{amount}} — applied to the next charge, or refunded from the payment.

payments.title: Payment history
payments.emptyBody: Every payment taken for this patient will be listed here with the visit it was applied to.

record.title: Record payment
record.ruleVisit: Applied to this visit first, then to the oldest unpaid charge.
record.rulePatient: Applied to the oldest unpaid charge first.
record.loadFailed: Couldn’t load this patient’s account. Close and try again.

problem.zero: The amount must be more than zero.
problem.over: The amount can’t be more than the {{amount}} owed.

record.specificHint: It takes at most what it still owes; the rest goes to the oldest charges.

advance.title: Paying in advance
advance.noPlan: There is no plan work left to pay for.
advance.planRule: It pays plan work only, as it is done, and what is left is always refundable.
advance.creditRule: It pays the {{amount}} owed first; the rest stays as credit.
advance.creditOnly: It stays as credit and pays the next charge.
advance.over: The amount can’t be more than the {{amount}} the plan still needs.
advance.kept: The rest is kept as credit

payment.over_outstanding: The amount is more than what is owed. Refresh and try again.
payment.nothing_outstanding: Nothing is owed on this account any more.
payment.invalid_target: That visit no longer has anything to pay.
payment.invalid_payer: That payer is no longer a billing contact of this patient.
payment.over_refund: That is more than what is left of the payment.
payment.has_refunds: Part of this payment was refunded; refund the rest instead of voiding it.
payment.not_reversible: This payment can no longer be refunded or voided.
payment.idempotency_mismatch: This payment was already recorded differently. Close and start again.
payment.over_plan_remaining: The amount is more than the plan still needs. Refresh and try again.
payment.no_open_plan: This patient has no plan work left to pay for in advance.
payment.not_held: This payment is no longer held for the treatment plan.

ledger.idempotency_mismatch: This form was already submitted with different details. Close it and start again.

adjust.title: Adjust balance

directionHint.less: A write-off, a courtesy, or a correction in the patient’s favour.
directionHint.more: A charge that has no visit, or a correction of an amount entered too low.

adjust.noteRequired: Say why, in a few words

release.title: Release {{receipt}} to credit?
release.body: The {{amount}} still held for the treatment plan becomes credit: it pays what is owed now, oldest first, or the next charge. It stays refundable.

refundPick.title: Refund a payment
refundPick.body: Choose the payment to refund. You can refund all of what is left of it or part of it.
refundPick.none: This patient has no payment to refund.
